-- Added `BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid` for CPU candidate history storage. The runner now keeps `HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT` pinned `CandidateMeta[32B]` copy slots, counts those slots against `BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES`, preallocates a bounded RAM `HistoryEntry[16B]` arena, pre-sizes a single per-rank disk arena file from `BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES`, writes new history to disk first, and falls back to RAM if the configured disk arena is exhausted or a disk write fails. Одобрено 3 заявки выполнено 5 команд
Причина 1xGPU smoke: старый backpressure reserve был средним по shard, но при one logical -> one Stream4 нужен worst-case reserve, если sibling уже в processing. Усиливаю только single-GPU stream3_has_writable_buffer: при busy sibling требовать available >= STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES.


Изменён 1 файл одобренных 3 запроса выполнено 6 команд
Final drain теперь требует больше итераций: цикл строит ready queue до drain, а dirty sibling становится доступен только после завершения running physical. Увеличиваю лимит final flush rounds под последовательную A/B обработку.


Изменён 1 файл одобренных 3 запроса выполнены 4 команды
Нашел stuck-сценарий: если device Stream4 уже завершил physical shard, но host еще не обработал event, Stream3 может снова выбрать тот же physical shard. Такой entry нельзя skip: нужно поставить pending за текущим host-running job. Убираю skip для running same physical; dedupe остается только по pending_shard_queued.

Изменён 1 файл одобренных 3 запроса выполнены 4 команды
Нашел stuck-сценарий: если device Stream4 уже завершил physical shard, но host еще не обработал event, Stream3 может снова выбрать тот же physical shard. Такой entry нельзя skip: нужно поставить pending за текущим host-running job. Убираю skip для running same physical; dedupe остается только по pending_shard_queued.

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_rotl64(std::uint64_t value, unsigned shift) {
    return (value << shift) | (value >> (64U - shift));

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_mix64(std::uint64_t value) {
    value ^= value >> 30U;
    value *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
    value ^= value >> 27U;
    value *= 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
    value ^= value >> 31U;
    return value;

    std::uint64_t value = hash.lo ^ hash128_rotl64(hash.hi, 32U) ^ domain_salt;
    value ^= hash128_mix64(hash.hi + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL);
    return hash128_mix64(value);
}

## 2026-05-26
- Restored the local repository baseline to commit `6d0ab88` before the new multi-GPU work, matching the user requirement to remove earlier same-day experimental changes.
- Added the first C++/CUDA multi-rank execution path without a new branch: `production_runner` reads `WORLD_SIZE`, `RANK`, and `LOCAL_RANK`, calls `cudaSetDevice(LOCAL_RANK)`, creates an NCCL communicator through file rendezvous, and passes the communicator into dispatcher code.
- Extended Stream 5 memory planning with segmented send/receive slots. `stream5_slot_count` equals `ring_count` for multi-rank and `1` for single-rank. `BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM` controls receive slot headroom; default is `2000000`.
- Wired Stream 3 multi-rank candidate flow: each ring writes remote `CandidateMeta` into its own Stream 5 send slot, Stream 5 exchanges counts and payloads via NCCL, and received remote candidates are collected into local shard buffers before Stream 4 processing.
- Added multi-rank finalization primitives: NCCL global score histogram, exact less/equal threshold split, target-rank load balancing, final history metadata exchange, `FinalRequest` exchange, `FinalResponse` exchange, and scatter into the next local frontier.
- Added rank-aware solution reconstruction without forced disk history: on global stop, all ranks finish their local CPU history, NCCL gathers solved metadata, the solved/controller rank broadcasts small parent-chain queries, source ranks read local RAM/disk history entries, and NCCL broadcasts responses until the full move path is reconstructed.
- Kept the `WORLD_SIZE=1` path as the existing single-GPU path: multi-rank collectives and extra Stream 5 exchange loops are only active when `world_size > 1`.
- Updated the Kaggle notebook to launch one C++ process per rank and set `WORLD_SIZE`, `RANK`, `LOCAL_RANK`, and `BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE`. The notebook also supports a source-archive datas<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="7926" />=301.2474`) after completing depth 10 and starting depth 11. Log scan found no fatal patterns and no `threshold_end=0`; the previous full/small frontier collapse disappeared. From depth 7 through 10, both ranks kept `next_frontier_size=33554432`, confirming that stale Stream4 histograms were the cause of the v80 collapse. Report saved as `test_results/kaggle_v81_reset_fix_validation_2026-05-27.md`.
- Added `BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid` for CPU candidate history storage. The runner now keeps `HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT` pinned `CandidateMeta[32B]` copy slots, counts those slots against `BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES`, preallocates a bounded RAM `HistoryEntry[16B]` arena, pre-sizes a single per-rank disk arena file from `BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES`, writes new history to disk first, and falls back to RAM if the configured disk arena is exhausted or a disk write fails. No pruning/remapping, GPU stream scheduling, finalization, or distributed reconstruction semantics changed; `route_packed.source_rank + parent_idx` remain the only rank/index linkage. Kaggle notebooks now use `HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid`, `HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2`, `HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=28*1000**3`, `HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=49*1000**3`, and `/tmp/beam_history_arena` so sparse history arena files are not packaged as notebook outputs.
- Kaggle version 83 validated `static_hybrid` history with `/tmp/beam_history_arena` on T4x2. The run hit the expected 300-second timeout (`return_code=-200`) after both ranks completed depth 9; log scan found no fatal patterns, no `threshold_end=0`, no arena exhaustion, and no disk write fallback. Rank 0 depth 9 reported `history_bytes_stored=2346674752`, `history_bytes_stored_ram=0`, and `history_bytes_stored_disk=1809803840`, confirming disk-first history storage was active. Full Kaggle output download succeeded because sparse history arena files were no longer under `/kaggle/working`. Report saved as `test_results/kaggle_v83_static_hybrid_history_tmp_arena_2026-05-27.md`.

State128 apply_move_flat_host(const State128& parent, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& generators, std::uint8_t move) {
    if (move >= MOVE_COUNT) {
        throw std::runtime_error("solution move exceeds MOVE_COUNT");
    }
    State128 child{};
    const std::uint64_t base = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(move) * STATE_STORAGE_LEN;
    for (std::uint32_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        child.v[p] = parent.v[generators[base + p]];
    }
    clear_state_padding(child);
    return child;
}

bool states_equal_storage(const State128& a, const State128& b) {
    for (std::uint32_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        if (a.v[p] != b.v[p]) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

struct Hash128Hasher {
    std::size_t operator()(Hash128 hash) const noexcept {
        return static_cast<std::size_t>(hash128_distribution_key(hash, 0x7f4a7c159e3779b9ULL));
    }
};

struct PackedSuffix {
    std::uint64_t moves = 0;
    std::uint8_t len = 0;
};

State128 apply_inverse_move_flat_host(
    const State128& child,
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& generators,
    std::uint8_t move) {
    if (move >= MOVE_COUNT) {
        throw std::runtime_error("inverse move exceeds MOVE_COUNT");
    }
    State128 parent{};
    const std::uint64_t base = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(move) * STATE_STORAGE_LEN;
    for (std::uint32_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        parent.v[generators[base + p]] = child.v[p];
    }
    clear_state_padding(parent);
    return parent;
}

PackedSuffix prepend_suffix_move(PackedSuffix suffix, std::uint8_t move) {
    if (move >= MOVE_COUNT) {
        throw std::runtime_error("suffix move exceeds MOVE_COUNT");
    }
    if (suffix.len >= 12U) {
        throw std::runtime_error("solved neighborhood suffix packing supports radius <= 12");
    }
    suffix.moves = (suffix.moves << 5U) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(move);
    ++suffix.len;
    return suffix;
}

void append_packed_suffix(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& moves, PackedSuffix suffix) {
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < suffix.len; ++i) {
        moves.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>((suffix.moves >> (5U * i)) & 31ULL));
    }
}

std::uint64_t next_power_of_two_u64(std::uint64_t value) {
    if (value <= 1ULL) {
        return 1ULL;
    }
    --value;
    for (std::uint32_t shift = 1U; shift < 64U; shift <<= 1U) {
        value |= value >> shift;
    }
    return value + 1ULL;
}

[49] user: Targeted tests прошли. Узкий стресс SHARD_CAPACITY=262144, GLOBAL_SPILL=0 теперь упирается в capacity: один physical сортируется, sibling почти полный, Stream3 получает spill_capacity=0. Проверяю нормальный 1xGPU запуск без искусственно малого shard cap.


Одобрено 3 заявки выполнено 5 команд
Причина 1xGPU smoke: старый backpressure reserve был средним по shard, но при one logical -> one Stream4 нужен worst-case reserve, если sibling уже в processing. Усиливаю только single-GPU stream3_has_writable_buffer: при busy sibling требовать available >= STREAM3_BATCH_CANDIDATES.


Изменён 1 файл одобренных 3 запроса выполнено 6 команд
Final drain теперь требует больше итераций: цикл строит ready queue до drain, а dirty sibling становится доступен только после завершения running physical. Увеличиваю лимит final flush rounds под последовательную A/B обработку.


Изменён 1 файл одобренных 3 запроса выполнены 4 команды
Нашел stuck-сценарий: если device Stream4 уже завершил physical shard, но host еще не обработал event, Stream3 может снова выбрать тот же physical shard. Такой entry нельзя skip: нужно поставить pending за текущим host-running job. Убираю skip для running same physical; dedupe остается только по pending_shard_queued.

#pragma once

#include "types.hpp"

#include <cstddef>

namespace beam {

Hash128 hash_state(const State128& state, const ZobristTable& zobrist);
ZobristTable make_deterministic_zobrist(std::uint64_t seed);
std::uint8_t owner_from_hash128(const Hash128& hash, std::uint32_t world_size);
std::uint32_t shard_from_hash128(const Hash128& hash, std::uint32_t shard_count);

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_rotl64(std::uint64_t value, unsigned shift) {
    return (value << shift) | (value >> (64U - shift));
}

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_mix64(std::uint64_t value) {
    value ^= value >> 30U;
    value *= 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9ULL;
    value ^= value >> 27U;
    value *= 0x94d049bb133111ebULL;
    value ^= value >> 31U;
    return value;
}

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_distribution_key(Hash128 hash, std::uint64_t domain_salt) {
    std::uint64_t value = hash.lo ^ hash128_rotl64(hash.hi, 32U) ^ domain_salt;
    value ^= hash128_mix64(hash.hi + 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL);
    return hash128_mix64(value);
}

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_owner_distribution_key(Hash128 hash) {
    return hash128_distribution_key(hash, 0x243f6a8885a308d3ULL);
}

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_shard_distribution_key(Hash128 hash) {
    return hash128_distribution_key(hash, 0x13198a2e03707344ULL);
}

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint32_t hash128_fingerprint32(Hash128 hash) {
    const std::uint64_t mixed = hash128_distribution_key(hash, 0xa4093822299f31d0ULL);
    std::uint32_t fingerprint = static_cast<std::uint32_t>(mixed ^ (mixed >> 32U));
    return fingerprint == 0U ? 1U : fingerprint;
}

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_bucket_key_0(Hash128 hash) {
    return hash128_distribution_key(hash, 0x082efa98ec4e6c89ULL);
}

BEAM_HOST_DEVICE inline std::uint64_t hash128_bucket_key_1(Hash128 hash) {
    return hash128_distribution_key(hash, 0x452821e638d01377ULL);
}

} // namespace beam

## 2026-05-26
- Restored the local repository baseline to commit `6d0ab88` before the new multi-GPU work, matching the user requirement to remove earlier same-day experimental changes.
- Added the first C++/CUDA multi-rank execution path without a new branch: `production_runner` reads `WORLD_SIZE`, `RANK`, and `LOCAL_RANK`, calls `cudaSetDevice(LOCAL_RANK)`, creates an NCCL communicator through file rendezvous, and passes the communicator into dispatcher code.
- Extended Stream 5 memory planning with segmented send/receive slots. `stream5_slot_count` equals `ring_count` for multi-rank and `1` for single-rank. `BEAM_STREAM5_RECV_CAPACITY_SCALE_PPM` controls receive slot headroom; default is `2000000`.
- Wired Stream 3 multi-rank candidate flow: each ring writes remote `CandidateMeta` into its own Stream 5 send slot, Stream 5 exchanges counts and payloads via NCCL, and received remote candidates are collected into local shard buffers before Stream 4 processing.
- Added multi-rank finalization primitives: NCCL global score histogram, exact less/equal threshold split, target-rank load balancing, final history metadata exchange, `FinalRequest` exchange, `FinalResponse` exchange, and scatter into the next local frontier.
- Added rank-aware solution reconstruction without forced disk history: on global stop, all ranks finish their local CPU history, NCCL gathers solved metadata, the solved/controller rank broadcasts small parent-chain queries, source ranks read local RAM/disk history entries, and NCCL broadcasts responses until the full move path is reconstructed.
- Kept the `WORLD_SIZE=1` path as the existing single-GPU path: multi-rank collectives and extra Stream 5 exchange loops are only active when `world_size > 1`.
- Updated the Kaggle notebook to launch one C++ process per rank and set `WORLD_SIZE`, `RANK`, `LOCAL_RANK`, and `BEAM_NCCL_ID_FILE`. The notebook also supports a source-archive datas<truncated omitted_approx_tokens="7926" />=301.2474`) after completing depth 10 and starting depth 11. Log scan found no fatal patterns and no `threshold_end=0`; the previous full/small frontier collapse disappeared. From depth 7 through 10, both ranks kept `next_frontier_size=33554432`, confirming that stale Stream4 histograms were the cause of the v80 collapse. Report saved as `test_results/kaggle_v81_reset_fix_validation_2026-05-27.md`.
- Added `BEAM_HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid` for CPU candidate history storage. The runner now keeps `HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT` pinned `CandidateMeta[32B]` copy slots, counts those slots against `BEAM_HISTORY_RAM_BYTES`, preallocates a bounded RAM `HistoryEntry[16B]` arena, pre-sizes a single per-rank disk arena file from `BEAM_HISTORY_DISK_BYTES`, writes new history to disk first, and falls back to RAM if the configured disk arena is exhausted or a disk write fails. No pruning/remapping, GPU stream scheduling, finalization, or distributed reconstruction semantics changed; `route_packed.source_rank + parent_idx` remain the only rank/index linkage. Kaggle notebooks now use `HISTORY_MODE=static_hybrid`, `HISTORY_SLOT_COUNT=2`, `HISTORY_RAM_BYTES=28*1000**3`, `HISTORY_DISK_BYTES=49*1000**3`, and `/tmp/beam_history_arena` so sparse history arena files are not packaged as notebook outputs.

State128 apply_move_flat_host(const State128& parent, const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& generators, std::uint8_t move) {
    if (move >= MOVE_COUNT) {
        throw std::runtime_error("solution move exceeds MOVE_COUNT");
    }
    State128 child{};
    const std::uint64_t base = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(move) * STATE_STORAGE_LEN;
    for (std::uint32_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        child.v[p] = parent.v[generators[base + p]];
    }
    clear_state_padding(child);
    return child;
}

bool states_equal_storage(const State128& a, const State128& b) {
    for (std::uint32_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        if (a.v[p] != b.v[p]) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

struct Hash128Hasher {
    std::size_t operator()(Hash128 hash) const noexcept {
        return static_cast<std::size_t>(hash128_distribution_key(hash, 0x7f4a7c159e3779b9ULL));
    }
};

struct PackedSuffix {
    std::uint64_t moves = 0;
    std::uint8_t len = 0;
};

State128 apply_inverse_move_flat_host(
    const State128& child,
    const std::vector<std::uint8_t>& generators,
    std::uint8_t move) {
    if (move >= MOVE_COUNT) {
        throw std::runtime_error("inverse move exceeds MOVE_COUNT");
    }
    State128 parent{};
    const std::uint64_t base = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(move) * STATE_STORAGE_LEN;
    for (std::uint32_t p = 0; p < STATE_STORAGE_LEN; ++p) {
        parent.v[generators[base + p]] = child.v[p];
    }
    clear_state_padding(parent);
    return parent;
}

PackedSuffix prepend_suffix_move(PackedSuffix suffix, std::uint8_t move) {
    if (move >= MOVE_COUNT) {
        throw std::runtime_error("suffix move exceeds MOVE_COUNT");
    }
    if (suffix.len >= 12U) {
        throw std::runtime_error("solved neighborhood suffix packing supports radius <= 12");
    }
    suffix.moves = (suffix.moves << 5U) | static_cast<std::uint64_t>(move);
    ++suffix.len;
    return suffix;
}

void append_packed_suffix(std::vector<std::uint8_t>& moves, PackedSuffix suffix) {
    for (std::uint32_t i = 0; i < suffix.len; ++i) {
        moves.push_back(static_cast<std::uint8_t>((suffix.moves >> (5U * i)) & 31ULL));
    }
}

std::uint64_t next_power_of_two_u64(std::uint64_t value) {
    if (value <= 1ULL) {
        return 1ULL;
    }
    --value;
    for (std::uint32_t shift = 1U; shift < 64U; shift <<= 1U) {
        value |= value >> shift;
    }
    return value + 1ULL;
}

    return ring_slot_count;
}

void set_ring_count_from_logical_shard(RuntimeConfig& config) {
    const std::uint64_t slot_candidates = ring_slot_candidate_count(config);
    const std::uint64_t local_capacity = local_frontier_capacity(config);
    const std::uint64_t logical_shard_size = ceil_div_u64(local_capacity, config.shard_count);
    config.ring_count = checked_u32(ceil_div_u64(logical_shard_size, slot_candidates), "ring_count");
    if (config.ring_count == 0U) {
        throw std::invalid_argument("derived RING_COUNT must be nonzero");
    }

# Project Agent Rules

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.
- Update `memory/CHANGELOG.md` after meaningful code, config, or architecture changes.
- Update `memory/PROMPTS.md` with user prompts that define requirements.
- Store test outputs, logs, and verification notes under `test_results/`.
- Prefer agent-centered code: explicit contracts, deterministic tests, small files, low hidden state.

## Architecture Source
- Primary architecture contract: `ARCHITECTURE_NEED.md`.
- Current Stream 4 implementation rule: use threshold + compact + CUB/fixed-temp sort/reduce + compact; do not use Stream 4 hash-table dedup.

## Implementation Guardrails
- `State128` logical bytes are `v[0..119]`.
- `State128` padding bytes are `v[120..127]`.
- Persistent frontier padding must be zero.
- `FinalResponse` may temporarily store `target_local_idx` in `v[120..123]`.
- `Hash128` is one logical 128-bit key stored as `{lo, hi}`.
- `CandidateMeta` must remain 32 bytes and 32-byte aligned.
- Stream 3 payload id must be original candidate id, not compact index.
- Stream 4 must not apply shard top-k or semantic shard cap.

## Operating Rule
- Read `AGENTS.md` before project edits.

- bucket_count=`pow2ceil(entries_upper)`

ФОРМУЛА:
- entries_upper=`sum(24^d, d=0..K)`
- bucket_count=`pow2ceil(entries_upper)`
- slots=`bucket_count*4`
- VRAM=`slots*(uint32 fingerprint 4B + Hash128 16B)=slots*20B`
- caveat=`если cuckoo placement не влезет, bucket_count удваивается`
